title: session.stop
description: Ends the session and its host: distinct from closing a connection or a view, neither of which ever stops a session. Served where the session capability stop is true (every craze serve), and answered {} at once: a receipt, not the stop's completion. New attaches are refused unavailable, reason closing, from before the receipt; the session's end follows on the stream (its closing records, then reset{session_closed}). A stop while one runs, from any client, is answered {} and joins it; a resent commandId is answered {} again. A host whose capability stop is false (a TUI-hosted session, an older host) answers unsupported, reason stop_unsupported.
